about: The evangelium of the formulary “Transferred Sixth Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, Jesus told the crowds this parable: The kingdom of heaven is like a grain of mustard, which a man took and sowed in his field. It is indeed the least of all seeds, but when it has grown, it is greater than all garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the sky come and live in its branches. He spoke another parable to them: The kingdom of heaven is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until the whole was leavened. Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the crowds, and He would not speak to them without parables, so that there might be fulfilled what had been spoken through the prophet, who said: I will open My mouth in parables; I will pour forth things hidden from the founding of the world.
